A Role To Die For (July 2025).description: DEM Productions presented the Barn Theatre production of Jordan Waller’s comedy A Role To Die For at Marylebone Theatre in summer 2025, following its Cirencester premiere. Directed by Derek Bond, the London transfer starred Tanya Franks, Philip Bretherton, Harry Goodson-Bevan and Obioma Ugoala in a farcical backstage crisis over casting a Bond-style spy franchise.
